I didn't have the benchmark table, so these are priors from general MLP behavior, not estimates fitted to the data. The strict conditions (consistent across all three datasets, with a practically meaningful margin) push most claims toward low values. I put the lowest value on claim 27, since a learning-rate step at the 1e-5 floor should have a small effect.
